name: waynestate/proctor
description: A framework-free PHP CLI that measures a PHP app against the version policy.

suggest.waynestate/advisor: ADVISOR module: lets your coding agent read proctor_rules and proctor_check, read-only.

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every CI check: manifest, tests, style, static analysis, agent-ready files, docs site, audit
scripts-descriptions.creed-copy:check: Verify the generated CREED reader copy in src/Creed/ matches a fresh export (set CREED_PATH to the CREED checkout)
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the docs site from docs/ into site/docs/ (Squire's docs builder): render the pages, fill the generated command and environment reference, and stamp the current version.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when the built docs site is stale or the generated command or environment reference has drifted from the CLI or source.
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
scripts-descriptions.site:versions: Write the supported-versions table on the front page from the bundled CREED policy (src/Creed/policy.json).
scripts-descriptions.site:versions-check: Fail when the supported-versions table on the front page is stale against the bundled policy.
